title:
SYMBOL CLINICAL : Treatment of severe ocular chemical burns by subconjunctival injection of allogeneic mesenchymal stem cells:
a multicentre, single-arm, open-label phase II trial
official:
SYMBOL CLINICAL : Treatment of severe ocular chemical burns by subconjunctival injection of allogeneic mesenchymal stem cells:
a multicentre, single-arm, open-label phase II trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of a protocol of subconjunctival injection of allogeneic BM-MSC in the acute phase of a severe chemical burn of the ocular surface (stage VI according to the Dua classification) on the preservation of the eyeball 6 months after the first injection.
conditions: Patient with severe eye chemical burns

interventions.name: FLUORESCEINE FAURE 0,5 POUR CENT, collyre en solution en récipient unidose
PARACETAMOL AGUETTANT 10 mg/ml, solution pour perfusion
STERDEX, pommade ophtalmique en récipient unidose
CHLORHYDRATE D’OXYBUPROCAINE THEA 1,6 mg/0,4 ml, collyre en récipient unidose
MIDAZOLAM VIATRIS 5 mg/ml, solution injectable ou rectale
PROPOFOL FRESENIUS 10 mg/ml, émulsion injectable ou pour perfusion

Bone marrow-derived Mesenchymal Stromal Cells  cryopreserved at passage P2, thawed, washed and syringe-conditioned in  0.9% NaCl - 0.5% human serum albumin injection solution at a dose of 5.10^6  Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
BETADINE 5 POUR CENT, solution pour irrigation oculaire en récipient unidose
REMIFENTANIL VIATRIS 2 mg, poudre pour solution injectable ou pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Uni or bilateral chemical burn of the ocular surface
3. Severe ocular burn of at least one eye: stage VI of Dua severity classification (involving the entire limbus and conjunctiva)
4. Time between burn and inclusion ≤ 15 days
5. Patient having received informed information about the study and having signed a consent to participate in the study
6. Affiliated or beneficiary of a social security scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. Impending corneal perforation (loss of corneal tissue > 2/3 of corneal thickness)
2. Adults subject to a legal protection measure (L1121-8) Persons deprived of their liberty by judicial or administrative decision, persons subject to psychiatric care under articles L3212-1 and L3123-1 and persons admitted to a health or social establishment for purposes other than research (L1121-6).
3. Pregnant or breast-feeding women
4. Participation in other interventional research (RIPH 1, clinical drug trials, clinical investigations) for the duration of their follow-up.
5. Secondary exclusion criteria : Grade VI of the Dua classification not confirmed by the expert ophthalmologist at the Hôpital Fondation A. de Rothschild
6. Secondary exclusion criteria : Patient did not receive subconjunctival injection of allogeneic BM-MSCs
7. Secondary exclusion criteria : Positive pregnancy test before the first subconjunctival injection of allogeneic BM-MSCs.
8. Ocular infection
9. Loss of palpebral substance with permanent corneal exposure
10. Known allergy (hypersensitivity) to human albumin preparations
11. Known history of total or partial limbic insufficiency
12. Uncontrolled glaucoma prior to ocular burns
13. Recipient of an organ or cell transplant
14. Previous cancer ≤ 5 years
15. Current treatment with immunosuppressive drugs (systemic corticosteroids, TNFα antagonists, azathioprine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, etc.)
